deploy-bot: Canary wave started — env=prod-usw, wave=miniwave-1, service=inference-runtime, image=runtime:1.3.0, tag=release-2026.03.15-rc3, commit=ba7f12e, traffic=2%, targets=12 hosts, initiated by @maya.k

maya.k: launching miniwave canary. Please watch p50/p95/p99, kv-cache hit rate, and OOMs. ETA for first metrics ~3m

alexc: noted. adding a smoke-check: query a standard prompt set and compare embeddings + generation latencies.

deploy-bot: Canary update — traffic=2% stable. Health checks passed (3/3). Latency p95=210ms, p99=420ms. Error rate=0.02%

samir: saw a couple of 502s on node inference-07 around +120s, investigating logs now

jin-ops: confirming log link: https://logs.redwood.internal/prod/inference/ba7f12e — looks like transient GPU OOM on inference-07, was on q8 quant path

maya.k: can we reduce per-instance concurrency on that node and retest? Also pin fallback: release-2026.02.28

deploy-bot: Action: reduced concurrency on inference-07, restarting container. New health check pass. traffic remains 2%

alexc: smoke-set diffs look okay except small embedding drift on one prompt. magnitude 0.6% — within acceptable tolerances per eval-runbook

release-coordinator: propose gentle ramp to 20% for 30m unless error rate >0.1% or p99 >600ms. Approve? @maya.k @samir

maya.k: approve :thumbsup:

samir: approve but keep pin in place. I'll watch for any more OOMs.

deploy-bot: Canary ramping to 20% over 5m. target=20%, start_traffic=2%, end_traffic=20%

deploy-bot: Canary update — traffic=10%. Health=ok. p95=230ms p99=480ms Error=0.03%

deploy-bot: Canary update — traffic=20%. Health=ok. p95=235ms p99=510ms Error=0.04%

maya.k: no new alerts. embedding drift stable. promote to full? We should coordinate cutover window 22:00 UTC if no regressions.

release-coordinator: schedule promo window 22:00 UTC, will notify downstream teams. Also create release note entry.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled at 22:00 UTC. Promotion command: ```/deploy promote --env prod-usw --tag release-2026.03.15-rc3 --pin-fallback=release-2026.02.28```

alexc: small nit: add rollback playbook link in the release note: https://wiki.redwood.dev/playbooks/deploy-rollback

deploy-bot: Promotion completed at 22:00 UTC. New stable tag=release-2026.03.15. All hosts updated. Final metrics: p95=240ms p99=520ms Error=0.04% :tada:

maya.k: thanks team. will monitor next 2 hours then close incident.
